s.p.learn.ai_p1: Biteganijwe ko mu minsi iri imbere, ushobora guhura n’ikoranabuhanga ry’ubuhanga (AI) rigufasha kuvugana ku rurimi rwawe n’urwego uriho, ku bijyanye n’icyo wifuza gukora (gutwara ibinyabiziga, akazi, ubuzima bwa buri munsi).
s.p.learn.ai_p2: Niba ushaka ko ikoranabuhanga ry’ibiganiro rikora, ukeneye serivisi y’inyuma. Ifunguzo ryaryo rigomba kuba ari ibanga ku rubuga rwawe, ntirikwiye kuba mu rubuga rw’ikoranabuhanga. Nta kintu na kimwe gishobora gukoreshwa n’amafranga atabanje kwemezwa n’ukoresha.
s.p.learn.cult_p1: Bitegerejwe: ibihugu n’uturere, indangagaciro, inkuru, inyandiko n’amashusho, gushakisha indimi.
s.p.learn.cult_p2: Ibikubiyemo bishyirwa hamwe nk’uko byakorwaga mu mashuri: buri nyandiko ishyirwaho rimwe, nta guhindura muri app.
s.p.learn.match_how: Kanda ku ijambo, hanyuma ukande ku gisobanuro cyaryo.
s.p.learn.no_voice: Ururimi rw’ikinyarwanda ntiruboneka kuri uyu murongo. Inyandiko ikurikira:

s.p.profil.vis_need_sync: Kugira ngo abafitanye isano bamenye ururimi rwawe, ubanza ufungure “Gushyingura muri konti yanjye”.
s.p.profil.never: Ntabwo bigaragara: email yawe, ibikoresho byawe, amagenamiterere yawe, igeragezwa ryawe muri Learn.
s.p.profil.cancel_note: Nta kintu na kimwe gishobora gukubirwa kugeza igihe ubonye “Gukubira”.
s.p.profil.consent: Amasezerano y’ubufatanye: Nshyigikiye ko profil yanjye y’ikinyarwanda ishyirwa kuri mudasobwa y’iyi gahunda (Supabase, Ubumwe bw’Uburayi) kugira ngo niyibone ku bindi bikoresho byanjye.Nshobora gukuraho iyi nyandiko mu gihe cyose nkanahagarika sync.
s.p.profil.consent_need: Kanda ku kadirishya k'ibyemezo kugira ngo ushyire kuri konti yawe, cyangwa ugahagarika guhuza.
s.p.profil.avatar_note: Avatar: ni amazina yawe y'indirimbo. Nta foto izajya itangwa cyangwa ishyirwamo.
